metadata.description: Balanced coverage: SecurityCritical types plus org config, connectors, Teams policies, Intune account protection, and Security & Compliance data protection (DLP, retention, labels). Good balance of security coverage vs. quota consumption.
metadata.quotaNote: ~29 resource types. May approach the 200 instances/run limit in tenants with many CA policies, transport rules, or Teams policies. Check Get-TCMQuota after creating the monitor.

controls.title: Conditional Access policies
controls.guidance: CA policies control who can access what and how. Any change to state, grant controls, conditions, or exclusions can open a security gap.

controls.title: Authentication method policies
controls.guidance: Controls which MFA methods are enabled, migration state, and per-method configuration.

controls.title: Authorization policies
controls.guidance: Governs app registration, consent framework, guest access, and admin consent workflow.

controls.title: Cross-tenant access policies
controls.guidance: Controls B2B collaboration trust with external organizations.

controls.title: Named location policies
controls.guidance: Defines trusted IP ranges and countries used in CA conditions.

controls.title: Anti-phishing policies and rules
controls.guidance: Impersonation protection, mailbox intelligence, and spoofing filters.

controls.title: Transport rules (mail flow)
controls.guidance: Mail flow rules that redirect, copy, or modify mail. Unauthorized changes can create hidden forwarding.

controls.title: DKIM signing configuration
controls.guidance: DKIM signs outbound mail to prevent spoofing.

controls.title: Content filter (anti-spam) policies
controls.guidance: Spam filtering thresholds, allowed/blocked senders, and IP allow lists.

controls.title: Safe Links policies
controls.guidance: URL rewriting and click-time scanning.

controls.title: Safe Attachments policies
controls.guidance: Sandbox detonation of email attachments.

controls.title: Exchange organization configuration
controls.guidance: Tenant-wide Exchange settings: mailbox auditing, SMTP AUTH, sharing policies. Changes affect all mailboxes.

controls.title: Mail connectors (inbound and outbound)
controls.guidance: Connectors route mail to/from partner organizations or on-premises. Unauthorized connectors can exfiltrate mail or bypass security scanning.

controls.title: Outbound spam filter policy
controls.guidance: Controls auto-forwarding rules and outbound spam thresholds. Disabling forwarding restrictions can enable data exfiltration.

controls.title: Malware filter rules
controls.guidance: Controls malware detection scope and actions. Changes to rule conditions can exclude users from protection.

controls.title: Teams federation configuration
controls.guidance: Controls which external domains can communicate with your users.

controls.title: Teams meeting policies and configuration
controls.guidance: Controls who can join meetings, present, record, and use AI features. Changes can expose meeting content to external participants.

controls.title: Teams messaging policies
controls.guidance: Controls message editing, deletion, read receipts, and URL previews.

controls.title: Teams app permission policies
controls.guidance: Controls which apps users can install in Teams. Loosening restrictions can allow data-exfiltrating or malicious apps.

controls.title: Intune account protection (local group membership)
controls.guidance: Controls local admin group membership on managed devices. Changes can grant local admin to unauthorized users.

controls.title: DLP compliance policies
controls.guidance: Data Loss Prevention policies protect sensitive data in Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams. Disabling or weakening DLP rules can expose PII, financial data, or health records.

controls.title: Retention policies and rules
controls.guidance: Retention policies ensure data is kept for compliance or deleted on schedule. Changes can violate regulatory requirements or enable evidence spoliation.

controls.title: Sensitivity label policies and tags
controls.guidance: Label policies publish sensitivity and retention labels to users. Changes can remove classification options or alter retention schedules.
